/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json, copy
original=json.load(open(\"input.json\"))
d=copy.deepcopy(original)
for sid,mid,org in [(\"g18\",\"m2\",\"Padruma Marine\"),(\"g19\",\"m4\",\"Vostira Imaging\")]:
    story=next(s for s in d[\"stories\"] if s[\"id\"]==sid)
    m=next(m for m in story[\"memories\"] if m[\"id\"]==mid)
    m[\"text\"]+=\" We also talked about news from \"+org+\".\"
    m[\"organizations\"].append({\"surface\":org,\"org\":org,\"relation\":\"other\"})
    assert org in {t[\"org\"] for t in story[\"timeline\"]}
    assert m[\"filler\"] and not m[\"jobs\"]
    assert all(o[\"surface\"] in m[\"text\"] for o in m[\"organizations\"])
    print(sid,mid,json.dumps(m,ensure_ascii=False))
    old=next(m for s in original[\"stories\"] if s[\"id\"]==sid for m in s[\"memories\"] if m[\"id\"]==mid)
    m[\"text\"]=old[\"text\"]
    m[\"organizations\"]=old[\"organizations\"]
assert d==original
print(\"Verified: only the two filler texts and their organization annotations change.\")'"
